answer: Remove per-identity capital bonding and the exploit is trivial: one operator forks a cheap agent a thousand times; identities sprout like a vine, each voting and farming rewards, so payout per honest node flattens into a mesa of near-zero yields while the attacker compounds. Bonding restores the defense: every identity stakes capital, clones share slashing, and any swarm that flares and burns rewards like a comet gets its stake destroyed.
